description: Server-generated TWR golden vectors. apps/api/src/__tests__/vaultClientTwrParity.test.ts drives these exact inputs through the real server pipeline (priceHistory + snapshot layer + GET /portfolios/:id/history?range=MAX) and asserts the server produces twrPct byte-for-byte; the paranoid client parity tests in clientMoney.test.ts consume the same vectors.

internalCashFeeDrag.description: V5 §16 2026-07-30 — the `fee` kind is INTERNAL for TWR, so a standing custody fee drags the curve instead of being divided back out of it like a withdrawal. Same deposit + buy as splitDateCashBuy, plus a 100 EUR fee on day -5. The client engine must reproduce this vector exactly; if it classified a fee as an external flow (or ignored it) the curves would diverge from the fee day on.
